Real product catalog live — pdp.popular/products.known hold 20 live real product PDPs, all priced in MXN and add-to-cart-able (re-verified Sept 17 2026, e.g. /30-x-30-puerta-de-acceso-exterior/ at Mex$34,234.75). (3) Pagination now works on both /mas-vendidos/ and /productos/entrega-rapida-en-mexico/, so the PLP and discovery pagination tests pass. The old 'catalog has 4 test/placeholder products' note is obsolete. KNOWN DEFICIENCY — missing <meta name="description"> on 2 pages (Sept 17 2026, tests intentionally failing per the site-deficiency policy; PDA admin must fix): seo.cy.js 'has a non-empty meta description' fails on BOTH 'SEO – Homepage' and 'SEO – PLP'. These are the ONLY 2 failures left in PDA's suite (283 tests: 222 passing, 2 failing, 59 skipped). (a) The HOMEPAGE has no meta description at all, though it already carries good Spanish copy in og:description and twitter:description — the fix is pasting that copy into the homepage's meta description field in BigCommerce admin. Same class and same one-field fix as FSE's /new-home/ gap. (b) The PLP /productos/entrega-rapida-en-mexico/ has none either. NOTE this second one SURFACED because of the Sept 17 PLP repoint below — the previous plp.main (/mas-vendidos/) does have a meta description, so seo.cy.js showed only 1 failure before. It is a genuine pre-existing gap on that category page, not a regression the suite caused, and it is worth surfacing: 'Entrega Rápida en México' is a commercially significant category to ship with no meta description. It is also the ONLY priced category missing one — /productos/cubiertas-de-ventilacion/, /productos/rejillas-para-puertas-y-kits-de-ventanas/ and all three /numeros-de-modelo/* candidates have one (all verified live Sept 17 2026). So if carrying this failure is ever unwanted, moving plp.main to /productos/cubiertas-de-ventilacion/ (12/12 priced, has a meta description, paginates to ?page=2, h1 'Cubiertas de Ventilación') makes the suite fully green with no other change — but that hides the gap rather than fixing it, so the deliberate choice here is to leave it failing until PDA admin adds the meta description. QUOTE-ONLY CATEGORIES ARE INTENTIONAL — PLP/discovery repointed (Sept 17 2026): PDA's catalog is mixed BY CATEGORY, not by product, and the price-less categories are deliberate business behaviour (confirmed by the store owner), not a pricing-config bug. Live counts Sept 17 2026 — fully priced: /productos/entrega-rapida-en-mexico/ (12/12), /productos/cubiertas-de-ventilacion/ (12/12), /productos/rejillas-para-puertas-y-kits-de-ventanas/ (12/12), /numeros-de-modelo/pa-ba-uap/ (12/12), /pa-ba-fri/ (8/8), /pa-ba-ivt/ (6/6); fully quote-only ('llame para precios'): /mas-vendidos/ (12/12), /mas-vendidos/resistentes-al-fuego/ (12/12), /productos/puertas-y-paneles-de-acceso/ (12/12), /productos/compuertas-de-desahogo-de-humo/ (12/12), /productos/trampillas-de-piso-y-techo/ (12/12); mixed: /productos/cajas-para-valvulas/ (3 priced / 8 quote-only). Because a quote-only category fails the PLP-grade assertProductCards price check, plp.main, plp.subcategory and discovery.mobileCategory were moved OFF /mas-vendidos/ and onto priced categories, and /mas-vendidos/ was dropped from discovery.categories — the BESTCA/FSE precedent (exclude the quote-only category) rather than ADC's plp.selectors.cardPrice:null, so PDA KEEPS per-card price coverage. This cleared all 10 failures. What changed and why each value: plp.main /mas-vendidos/ -> /productos/entrega-rapida-en-mexico/ (12/12 priced, h1 'Entrega Rápida en México', has pagination to ?page=2); plp.mainHeading -> 'Entrega Rápida en México'; plp.breadcrumbLabel 'Más vendidos' -> 'Productos' — this one is load-bearing: plp.cy.js asserts cy.contains('a', breadcrumbLabel) on BOTH the main PLP and the subcategory page, so the value must be a crumb the two share, and 'Productos' is the common parent of every /productos/<child>/ trail (Inicio > Productos > <child>); plp.subcategory /mas-vendidos/resistentes-al-fuego/ -> /productos/cubiertas-de-ventilacion/ (12/12 priced; entrega-rapida-en-mexico has NO children, so the subcategory slot takes a SIBLING under the same parent — it still exercises what that suite is for, a 3-level breadcrumb trail plus products and sidebar on a nested category); discovery.mobileCategory -> /productos/entrega-rapida-en-mexico/ (was the source of discovery.mobile.cy.js's 4 device failures). Unchanged and re-verified still valid on the new page: plp.selectors.bestSellers ('.sidebarBlock a[href*="mas-vendidos"]' — a sidebar link that renders on every category page, independent of which PLP is configured) and plp.selectors.pagination.pageTwoToken ('page=2'). If /mas-vendidos/ is ever priced up, it can go back to being plp.main; nothing else would need to change. ZOHO GCLID SNIPPET — site-wide, suppressed (updated Sept 17 2026; supersedes the Aug 31 2026 'contact/quote pages' note): PDA injects Zoho's GCLID snippet on EVERY page, not just the two form pages. Each page loads forms.zoho.com/js/zf_gclid_live.js `defer` and then runs, from inline page code, setTimeout(function(){ downloadHtmlGclid(); }, 500) where downloadHtmlGclid does `var gclid = g_c(GAd.indexValueArr[0]);` (line A) then `var fieldobj = document.forms.form.zc_gad;` (line B). Both lines are unguarded, so the timer throws one of two errors — two arms of ONE defect: (A) 'ReferenceError: g_c is not defined' when the deferred helper has not executed within the hardcoded 500ms — a pure network race, intermittent (~1 run in 3), confirmed pre-existing by a 3x/3x A-B on main vs branch (2/3 vs 1/3); (B) 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading zc_gad)' when the helper DID load, because document.forms.form is undefined on any page with no <form name='form'>. Only /contactenos/ and /cotiza/ carry that name (their Zoho forms) — document.forms is keyed by name/id ONLY, and the theme's search forms are class="form", not name="form". So on the homepage, PLPs, PDPs, category and search pages, arm B fires whenever arm A does not, making the throw effectively UNCONDITIONAL there rather than a flake; it took out all 6 discovery.cy.js tests until suppressed. Verified live Sept 17 2026 against the served HTML: the snippet is present on /, /mas-vendidos/, /productos/entrega-rapida-en-mexico/, a PDP and /search.php, and name='form' on none of them. PDA is still the ONLY store in the fleet that calls the helper from inline code (homepage scan of all nine, Sept 17 2026); the other eight merely load the script. Suppressed by a single KNOWN_BUGGY_SCRIPTS messagePattern in checks.js covering both arms, because left unsuppressed arm B fails whichever test happens to be running and wipes out PDA's discovery/homepage/plp/pdp signal wholesale. Low-severity for real users either way — the snippet's only job is to copy a gclid into a hidden field, and on a page with no form there is nothing to copy it into. PDA devs notified: the fix is to hook the script's load event instead of guessing a 500ms timer, AND to null-guard document.forms.form (or stop injecting the snippet on pages with no Zoho form). Remove the suppression once that ships.
